steps.title: Read the AI's Response
steps.task: Import OpenAI from the openai library.

steps.title: Getting the API Key
steps.task: Retrieve the OpenAI API key stored in Google Colab Secrets and store it in a variable called api_key.

steps.title: Give the AI a Task
steps.task: Set the model to gpt-4o-mini and store the investigation question in a variable called prompt.

steps.title: Send Your First AI Request
steps.task: Use client.responses.create() to send the model and prompt to the AI, and store the result in a variable called response.

steps.title: Read the AI's Response
steps.task: Print the AI's generated text from the response object.

steps.title: Give the AI a Search Tool
steps.task: Import the three components needed to create an AI agent, connect to an OpenAI model, and load search tools.

steps.title: Connect the Search Service
steps.task: Set up the SERPAPI_API_KEY environment variable using the SerpAPI key stored in Google Colab Secrets.

steps.title: Give Your AI a Search Tool
steps.task: Load the SerpAPI search tool and give our AI access to web search.

steps.title: Create the AI Agent
steps.task: Create the AI agent using the create_agent method.

steps.title: Run the AI Agent
steps.task: Ask the AI agent about what has been reported recently about Heal Genie Lab's treatment program by using invoke().

steps.title: Read the Agent's Response
steps.task: Extract and print the agent's final response from the response object.
